feeds.title: Exceptional Vision Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date by reading the latest news and blog articles from our practice. We offer a full range of eye health services to clients of all ages - all with personalized attention and a smile. In our eye care office, every patient is treated warmly. Individualized attention is the foundation of our care, to ensure that your eyes remain healthy.

feeds.title: Family Vision Development Center Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date on the latest eye-care tips for children and adults, changes to the Vision Therapy industry, techniques that can improve your vision, trends. At the Family Vision Development Center we offer full service eye care. This means we can provide all of the vision needs for your whole family. This includes general eye exams, advanced vision therapy services, contact lens fittings and the ability to diagnose and treat ocular disease such as glaucoma, cataracts, macular degeneration, dry eye and diabetes just to name a few.

feeds.title: Smart Vision Optometrists » Vision Therapy
feeds.description: Learn more about Vision Therapy, our services, vision disorders and more! Smart Vision Optometrists is a Behavioural Optometry group. As behavioural optometrists, we strive to have a transformational impact on our patients' lives by using the latest technology eye health assessments to achieve cutting-edge outcomes both in eyewear and visual performance.

feeds.title: The VisionHelp Blog
feeds.description: VisionHelp represents a group of leading Optometric vision specialists in the U.S. who serve to provide greater awareness and understanding of the science and best practices for training the visual brain. VisionHelp consists of University Professors, past presidents of national and state associations and authors of professional publications on various aspects of vision treatment and vision therapy. Our mission is advocacy to eliminate the senseless struggle through better vision for humankind.

feeds.title: Wow Vision Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with what is happening at Wow Vision Therapy by subscribing to our blog. At Wow Vision Therapy, we are a world-class developmental and rehabilitative vision therapy practice.

feeds.title: Brighter Outlook Vision Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about vision and vision therapy on Brighter Outlook Vision's All Eyes on Vision blog. Provides extremely helpful and informative insights into the healing nature of Vision Therapy and rehabilitation. Read stories of people who recovered from vision-related injuries and many other updates.

feeds.title: Discovering Vision Therapy Blog
feeds.description: The blog of The Vision Therapy Center, dedicated to helping parents, educators and optometrists discover vision therapy. The Vision Therapy Center provides optometric vision therapy to correct functional vision problems not always detected by typical vision screenings.

feeds.title: Anderson Vision Therapy Blog
feeds.description: At Anderson Family Vision Therapy, each member of our vision care team is selected by Dr. Nathan Anderson based upon his or her experience, professional demeanor, and dedication to providing personalized care to our optometry patients. feeds.title: Samyak Eyecare Blog
feeds.description: Explore our articles on vision therapy, eye care, our services and more! Samyak Eye Care Clinic is a complete eye care clinic where comprehensive eye examinations are done with globally acclaimed technologies. We are specialized in contact lens implantation.

feeds.title: Vision and Learning Center Blog
feeds.description: Learn what's new at Vision and Learning Center in Collegeville, PA. The Vision and Learning Center provides vision therapy, which is a highly effective non-surgical treatment for many common visual problems.

feeds.title: Vision Therapy Institute of Calgary Blog
feeds.description: Keep up-to-date on the latest vision-related news and eye care events in our Practice. The items are displayed by year and month. Our clinic is equipped with OCT and digital retinal imaging, visual field/peripheral vision testing, Nike Strobe Vapor glasses, FITLIGHT, Sanet Vision Integration, Vergence Training System, Amblyopia INET and Perceptual Training System.

feeds.title: Performance Vision Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Get more information on vision therapy, issues, and more! We offer individualized, one on one vision therapy. Performance Vision Therapy is a practice dedicated to high quality Neuro-Developmental Optometry for infants through adults. Opening in 2014, we pride ourselves on being a stand-alone clinic committed to transforming lives through vision therapy.

feeds.title: Saugeen Shores Vision Therapy Centre Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about vision therapy, how to deal with and help people undergoing vision therapy and more! feeds.description: Learn more about Vision Therapy, eye care and more! Washington Vision Therapy Center can help treat your functional vision problems. We offer general optometry as well as vision therapy treatment, which helps deal with and correct developmental issues with a person's vision. While children are our most common patients, we frequently treat adults as well.

feeds.title: Vision Science Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Vision Science Academy provides exceptional education support, facilitates innovative research, and disseminates knowledge to advance skills in vision science to help improve patient care. The Vision Sciences Academy is an international organisation of vision science professionals who are interested in the Science of Vision.

feeds.description: Learn more on our blog about equipment and the latest happenings in eye care. We have been committed to serving the Regina community since 1986, when Dr. Robert McKay first opened his practice. We have provided the community with a high standard of care ever since.

feeds.description: Advanced Vision Therapy Center's blog will keep you up-to-date on the latest advances and research in the areas of vision therapy, binocular vision dysfunction, acquired brain injuries, sports vision, and more.
